concerns.text: Phase 0 (Data Acquisition) is listed as a separate phase but no Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) from the spec is explicitly mapped to it. The spec’s FR‑001 already covers dataset download/ingestion, so this extra phase is over‑reaching without a traceable requirement.

Phase 8 (Validation & Cleanup) addresses constitution principles (I, III, VII) but no FR or SC from the spec. While useful for reproducibility, it is not linked to any spec‑defined requirement, constituting an un‑anchored plan element.
